question: An engineer needs to implement a solution that will provide telemetry of MDS 9000 switches in a SAN fabric. The solution should use Cisco Data Center Network Manager (DCNM) with SAN Insights feature. Which three steps are required to deploy the solution? (Choose three.)
options: Activate ENTERPRISE_PKG license on target switches.
Select a target Fabric to be monitored.
Select the target ports to be monitored for telemetry data.
Select a target VSAN to be monitored.
Activate SAN_ANALYTICS_PKG license on target switches.
Configure name resolution between the devices.
theory: Deploying SAN Insights in DCNM requires enabling SAN Analytics telemetry on the switches, via the SAN_ANALYTICS_PKG license, since SAN Insights consumes analytics data the switch hardware generates, then, within DCNM, choosing which fabric to monitor and which specific ports on those switches should have analytics/telemetry data collected and streamed - VSAN or name-resolution settings aren't part of enabling the feature itself, since SAN Analytics operates at the port/flow level, not per-VSAN. (Cisco DCNM SAN Insights documentation / web research)
